source: UserInfo values: CreatureStat/PlayerStat + Calculator + Func* + item funcs + armor sets (geared players)
note: Each case: input (what to build) and expected (user_info = the ints the packet carries, raw = the full doubles and the probes). Players are built like Player.restore + rewardSkills: gear equipped first (Inventory.equipItem, armor set and item skills run), then the auto-get skills (repeated until every skill is at its highest level), then refreshExpertisePenalty and refreshOverloaded. input.skills = the auto-get skills in the order their functions stay in the calculators; input.derived_skills = skills the player knows on top of them (armor set, item, grade penalty). probes = Creature.calcStat(stat, init) with the init value the formulas use, key 'stat@init'. Doubles are Java's shortest round-trip text; read run/walk speeds and p_atk as f64.
